pulse.description: AI-powered news intelligence platform with multi-perspective analysis and real-time verification.
pulse.longDescription: Pulse is a modern, high-performance news aggregation platform that uses AI to extract, summarize, and verify news content from various sources. It delivers a clean, clutter-free reading experience with multi-perspective editorial analysis, prediction markets integration, and fact-checking capabilities.
pulse.overview: Pulse redefines how people consume news by combining AI-driven editorial analysis with real-time fact verification. The platform ingests content from multiple RSS sources, groups semantically similar stories, and generates editorial rewrites in five distinct styles — from deep analytical breakdowns to quick TL;DR summaries. Six specialized AI experts provide unique perspectives across politics, economics, science, sports, culture, and health.
pulse.problem: Traditional news platforms deliver single-voice reporting that often lacks depth and verification. Users are overwhelmed by information pollution, with no easy way to cross-reference claims, understand multiple perspectives, or verify facts in real-time.
pulse.solution: Pulse's editorial render pipeline uses Gemini 2.5 Flash to extract structured fact tables from articles, generate rewrites in 5 editorial styles, and deterministically verify numbers and dates to prevent hallucinations. Combined with Polymarket prediction integration and smart bookmarking, users get a complete intelligence toolkit.

aiEditorial.title: AI Editorial Pipeline
aiEditorial.description: Generates rewrites in 5 styles (Analytic, TL;DR, Fact Only, Simple, Humor) with fact extraction using Gemini AI.

prediction.title: Prediction Markets
prediction.description: Real-time Polymarket integration with AI-powered probability analysis by Dr. Marcus Chen.

ingest.title: Smart Ingest System
ingest.description: Automatic RSS/Atom discovery, full-text extraction with Readability, content hashing, and 15-min fetch intervals.

evidence.title: Evidence Highlighting
evidence.description: Links claims directly to primary sources with deterministic verification of numbers and dates.

pulse.impact: Increases decision speed with verified multi-source news insights and less information noise.

smart-planning.description: AI-powered workforce scheduling and shift planning system for retail stores and businesses.
smart-planning.longDescription: Smart Planning is an intelligent shift planning and employee management system designed for retail stores. It automatically generates optimal weekly schedules based on business rules, employee availability, skills, and budget constraints — with drag-and-drop manual editing support.
smart-planning.overview: Smart Planning transforms workforce management with an AI-driven scheduling engine that considers employee skills, availability, labor laws, and budget constraints. Managers can view timeline-based daily plans, lock approved shifts, and switch between Protective, Balanced, and Aggressive planning modes to optimize staffing levels.
smart-planning.problem: Retail managers spend hours manually creating weekly shift schedules, juggling employee preferences, skill requirements, labor regulations, and budget limits. Mistakes lead to understaffing, overtime costs, and employee dissatisfaction.
smart-planning.solution: An auto-scheduling engine that generates optimal plans with one click, respecting all constraints. Managers can fine-tune with drag-and-drop, lock approved shifts, track budget in real-time, and get instant validation against business rules.

autoScheduling.title: Auto Scheduling
autoScheduling.description: One-click optimal schedule generation based on rules, skills, availability, and budget constraints.

budget.description: Real-time weekly hour budget tracking with distribution across departments and planning modes.

employee.description: Complete personnel management with skills, departments, availability, and leave tracking.

timeline.description: Daily detailed shift visualization with drag-and-drop editing and shift locking.

smart-planning.impact: Reduces shift planning time while lowering overtime risk and staffing errors.

gozcu.description: Enterprise-grade inventory, equipment failure, and maintenance management system (mini-CMMS).
gozcu.longDescription: Gözcu is a corporate-level Asset Management / mini-CMMS web application for managing company inventory, tracking equipment failures and downtime, and planning preventive maintenance with checklists, notifications, and detailed audit logging.
gozcu.overview: Gözcu provides a complete asset management solution for industrial and manufacturing environments. It covers the full lifecycle from machine registration and inventory tracking to failure reporting, downtime analysis, cost tracking, and preventive maintenance scheduling — all with role-based access control and full audit logging.
gozcu.problem: Manufacturing and industrial companies often rely on spreadsheets or outdated systems to track equipment, failures, and maintenance schedules. This leads to missed maintenance windows, unexpected downtime, and inability to analyze failure patterns.
gozcu.solution: A modern web-based CMMS with intuitive dashboards showing critical machines and overdue maintenance, automated notification system for upcoming tasks, comprehensive failure tracking with cost analysis, and Excel export for all reports.

machine.description: Detailed machine registry with filtering, search, and complete equipment lifecycle tracking.

failure.title: Failure Management
failure.description: Failure records with downtime tracking, cost analysis, and pattern detection across equipment.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Planning
maintenance.description: Weekly/monthly preventive maintenance scheduling with checklist support and overdue alerts.

rbac.title: RBAC & Audit Log
rbac.description: Admin, Technician, and Observer roles with complete audit logging of all critical operations.

gozcu.impact: Cuts unplanned downtime and maintenance delays for more reliable operations.

academy360.description: Multi-tenant football academy management platform with role-based dashboards for athletes, coaches, parents, and admins.
academy360.longDescription: Academy360 is a comprehensive football/soccer player development platform designed for youth academies (ages 8-18). It provides role-based dashboards for athletes, coaches, parents, club admins, and super admins — covering everything from training programs and skill tracking to attendance, payments, and performance analytics.
academy360.overview: Academy360 is a multi-tenant SaaS platform that digitalizes youth football academy operations. With 55+ API routes, a unified dashboard architecture, and PWA support, it serves five distinct user roles — each with a tailored experience. Coaches build weekly training plans, track skill scores with radar charts, and write development notes. Athletes log exercise completions and view their progress. Parents monitor their children's development and payments. Club admins manage members, groups, sessions, and fees. The platform includes a library of 105 exercises across 5 categories, 28 training templates for 7 age groups, and comprehensive analytics with attendance, performance, and season comparison charts.
academy360.problem: Youth football academies typically manage player development through spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and paper-based systems. Coaches lack tools to systematically track individual skill progression across technical, physical, and behavioral dimensions. Parents have no visibility into their child's training attendance or development trajectory. Club administrators struggle with member management, payment tracking, and cross-group coordination.
academy360.solution: A purpose-built platform with role-based access control and Row-Level Security ensuring data isolation between organizations. The unified dashboard architecture serves all roles from a single URL namespace with automatic role switching. Features include a structured exercise library with difficulty levels, a completion tracking system, coach skill scoring with radar chart visualization, weekly plan builder, player comparison tools, and a complete manual payment tracking system — all wrapped in a mobile-responsive PWA.

dashboards.description: Five tailored experiences for athletes, coaches, parents, club admins, and super admins with seamless role switching.

training.description: 105 exercises across 5 categories with 3 difficulty levels, 28 age-group templates, and weekly plan builder.

skill.description: Individual skill scoring with radar charts, weakness analysis, player comparison, and monthly development archives.

multiTenant.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
multiTenant.description: Secure organization isolation with Supabase RLS, OTP authentication, and 55+ validated API endpoints.

academy360.impact: Makes player development measurable and centralizes academy operations in one platform.

iro-beautyzone.description: Premium nail art studio website with online appointment booking, service gallery, and client reviews.
iro-beautyzone.longDescription: IRO Beautyzone is a sleek, mobile-first website for a premium nail art studio in Istanbul. It features online appointment booking, a service showcase, client testimonials, and a gallery — designed to convert visitors into booked clients.
iro-beautyzone.overview: IRO Beautyzone's website serves as the digital storefront for a premium nail art studio in Suadiye, Kadıköy, Istanbul. With a 4.9/5 customer satisfaction rating prominently displayed, the site builds trust through client testimonials and showcases the studio's work through a curated gallery. The 24/7 online booking system converts visitors into appointments.
iro-beautyzone.problem: Beauty studios often rely on phone calls and Instagram DMs for bookings, leading to missed appointments and lost revenue. They need a professional online presence that showcases their work and makes booking effortless.
iro-beautyzone.solution: A mobile-first website with prominent call-to-action buttons for booking, WhatsApp integration for instant communication, a visual gallery showcasing work quality, and client testimonials that build trust — all wrapped in a premium design that reflects the studio's brand.

hushu.description: An ad-free, deliberately minimal Quran app that promises calm and depth — read and listen to the meaning, travel through revelation, and explore the names of God in four languages.
hushu.longDescription: Hushu is a mobile Quran experience built around understanding and depth rather than indexing. It pairs a deliberately quiet, ad-free interface with a voiced meaning (sesli meal) for every verse, a chronological journey through revelation, contemplative explorations of the 99 names, a reflection library, and a memorization screen — all available in Turkish, English, German, and Spanish.
hushu.overview: Hushu reframes how people engage with the Quran on mobile. Most apps optimize for navigation and recitation; Hushu optimizes for meaning, depth, and presence. The interface is intentionally minimal and completely ad-free. Each day it offers verses matched to three feelings you choose, every verse can be heard as a fully narrated meaning (sesli meal), and dedicated modules let you travel through revelation in order, explore the depths of the 99 names, reflect through a curated library, and memorize — all in four languages: Turkish, English, German, and Spanish.
hushu.problem: Most Quran apps are cluttered, ad-filled, and treat the text as something to navigate and recite rather than understand. Readers who want depth — the meaning, the context of revelation, the names of God, a calm space to reflect and memorize — are left stitching together several noisy tools, and almost nothing serves Turkish, English, German, and Spanish speakers with the meaning spoken aloud.
hushu.solution: Hushu brings depth into one quiet, ad-free app. A voiced meaning (sesli meal) narrates every verse; a chronological 'Revelation Journey' adds the context of why each passage came down; the 99 names open into searchable depth; a reflection library and a memorization screen support practice — and a custom audio pipeline delivers consistent narration across four languages (TR, EN, DE, ES) under a clean freemium model.

voicedMeal.title: Voiced Meaning (Sesli Meal)
voicedMeal.description: A fully narrated translation of every verse in a natural, calm voice — available in Turkish, English, German, and Spanish.

vahiy.title: Revelation Journey
vahiy.description: Read the Quran in the order it was revealed, each stop framed with the context of why it came down.

esma.title: Names of God, in Depth
esma.description: Explore the 99 names by meaning or feeling, each opening into its own contemplative detail.

tefekkur.title: Reflection & Memorization
tefekkur.description: A curated reflection library and a dedicated memorization screen — calm, focused, and entirely ad-free.

hushu.impact: Turns the Quran from something to scroll into something to sit with — making meaning, context, and depth accessible, calm, and ad-free in four languages.

orni.description: Early childhood education ecosystem connecting kindergartens, instructors, and parents in one platform.
orni.longDescription: Orni is a comprehensive early childhood education platform for ages 0–6 that brings together kindergartens, independent instructors, and parents. Parents can discover schools with advanced filters, explore instructor profiles, register for weekly workshops, and read verified reviews — all in one place.
orni.overview: Orni addresses the fragmented nature of early education discovery. Parents navigating kindergarten choices and workshop registrations for young children face scattered information across Instagram, WhatsApp groups, and word-of-mouth. Orni centralizes the entire experience: filtering schools by city, age group, pedagogical approach, and budget; exploring instructor profiles; booking art, drama, music, and nature workshops; and reading moderated parent reviews.
orni.problem: Parents of young children struggle to find reliable, filtered information about kindergartens and early education workshops. The process is fragmented across social media, phone calls, and manual searches — leading to poor choices and missed opportunities for early development.
orni.solution: A three-sided marketplace platform where kindergartens publish profiles and manage enrollment, instructors create workshop schedules and connect with schools, and parents discover, filter, book, and review — all with a calm, accessible design built around the needs of families with young children.

workshop.title: Workshop Calendar & Booking
workshop.description: Weekly and monthly workshop calendar for art, drama, music, and nature activities with one-click registration and capacity tracking.

instructor.title: Instructor Profiles
instructor.description: Dedicated profiles for early education instructors showing specialization, experience, pedagogical approach, and available workshops.

reviews.title: Verified Parent Reviews
reviews.description: 5-star moderated review system with real parent experiences for kindergartens and instructors.

orni.impact: Simplifies early education decisions for families and gives kindergartens and instructors a professional digital presence.
